words.definition: the work that a person does to earn money.
words.example: She found a new job last month.

words.definition: the series of jobs a person has during their working life.
words.example: He wants a career in medicine.

words.definition: a business that sells goods or services.
words.example: She works for a big company.

words.definition: a person who works for a company or another person.
words.example: All employees must arrive by nine o'clock.

words.definition: a person or company that pays people to work for them.
words.example: My employer gave me a day off.

words.definition: a meeting where someone is asked questions about a job.
words.example: I have a job interview tomorrow.

words.definition: a document that describes your education and work experience.
words.example: Send your resume before Friday.

words.definition: the money a person earns regularly for their work.
words.example: Her salary increased this year.

words.definition: a person you work with.
words.example: My colleagues are very friendly.

words.definition: a room or building where people do business work.
words.example: He works in an office in the city.

words.definition: a person who is in charge of a business or a team of workers.
words.example: The manager gave us new tasks.

words.definition: knowledge or skill gained from doing a job.
words.example: You need experience for this job.

words.definition: a move to a higher position at work.
words.example: She got a promotion after two years.

words.definition: to stop working, usually because of age.
words.example: My grandfather retired last year.

words.definition: to formally ask for a job.
words.example: I applied for the job online.

words.definition: to give someone a job.
words.example: The company decided to hire two new workers.

words.definition: to teach someone the skills needed for a job.
words.example: New employees train for two weeks.

words.definition: a period of time that a person works.
words.example: He works the night shift at the factory.

words.definition: a piece of work that must be done.
words.example: I finished all my tasks today.

words.definition: the time by which something must be finished.
words.example: We have to meet the deadline on Friday.

text: Last year, I decided to change my career and look for a new job. First, I updated my resume and started to apply for different positions online. After two weeks, a company called me for an interview. I was very nervous, but the manager was friendly and asked about my experience. A week later, they decided to hire me! On my first day, my new employer explained my main tasks and introduced me to my colleagues. I had to train for a few days to learn how things worked in the office. My salary was better than my last job, and I liked my new shift, which started at nine in the morning. My manager always gives us clear deadlines, so we know exactly when to finish our tasks. After six months, I worked very hard and received a promotion. Now I have more responsibility, but I also enjoy my job more. My colleagues say that if I keep working like this, I could become a manager myself one day. I don't plan to retire for many years, but I already feel proud of how much I have achieved in my career.
